description: This file defines the OutboundEmailAccounts class, extending a parent class, providing functionality related to managing outbound email account settings within the SuiteCRM application. It includes properties for SMTP configuration, methods for saving and retrieving email account data, access control logic, and UI components for testing email settings.

classes.name: OutboundEmailAccounts
classes.description: Represents outbound email account configurations, including SMTP settings, access permissions, and methods for managing email account data, access control, and UI interactions within the SuiteCRM environment.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Overrides the parent save method to include custom logic for encrypting passwords, managing authentication types, and saving settings.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Overrides retrieve to include decryption of stored passwords and access control checks.

methods.name: getUserOutboundAccounts
methods.description: Returns a list of outbound email accounts accessible to the current user, with filtering based on admin status and user type.

methods.name: create_new_list_query
methods.description: Builds a SQL query for listing email accounts, with restrictions based on user permissions.

methods.name: hasAccessToPersonalAccount
methods.description: Determines if the current user has access to the personal email account.

methods.name: logPersonalAccountAccessDenied
methods.description: Logs access denial events related to personal account access attempts by non-authorized users.

methods.name: ACLAccess
methods.description: Provides access control logic based on user permissions and account type.

methods.name: getFromAddress
methods.description: Returns the email address used as the sender, defaulting to the SMTP user if not specified.

methods.name: getFromName
methods.description: Returns the name used as the sender.

methods.name: getReplyToAddress
methods.description: Returns the reply-to email address, falling back to the from address if not set.

methods.name: keepWriteOnlyFieldValues
methods.description: Preserves values of fields marked as write-only when fetching data.

methods.name: getPasswordChange
methods.description: Returns HTML/JavaScript code for password change UI component.

methods.name: getEmailProviderChooser
methods.description: Returns HTML for selecting email provider options.

methods.name: getSendTestEmailBtn
methods.description: Returns HTML/JavaScript for the 'send test email' button and its dialog.

methods.name: isAdminOnlyAction
methods.description: Determines if the current view is restricted to admin users.

methods.name: isSecurityGroupBasedAction
methods.description: Checks if an action is security group-based.

methods.name: isNotAllowedAction
methods.description: Checks if an action is disallowed.
